Group model · PMV

One number for everyone in the room

People under the same conditions vote differently. Under cooling and cold exposure, PMV was about 30% accurate.

Chen et al., 2023; Wu et al., 2021

Personalized model

Learn from each occupant

Often more accurate than PMV, but it needs many sensors and many labeled votes in every new building.

Ngarambe et al., 2020; Aerts, 2019; Čulić et al., 2021

Can thermal comfort be predicted with acceptable accuracy from a reduced set of practical sensors and only a small amount of locally labeled data?

The research question

Related work

Two lines of work meet here

Open question: can a Transformer pretrained on ASHRAE DB II be adapted with a small adapter to a 3-signal wearable and environmental setup, and does the backbone matter for transfer?

The idea

Borrow from 44,124 labels

Few labels, few inputs, a rare warm class and noisy votes: borrow knowledge from ASHRAE, then adapt it to the local sensors.

Meanwhile, by the pond

A conversation about small data

After the closing scene of Oppenheimer (2023)
Dialogue rewritten for 596 labels

Oppenheimer · me

When I came to you with those calculations, we thought an ANN and an RNN could learn comfort from 596 labels alone.

Einstein · a Transformer pretrained on ASHRAE

I remember it well. What of it?

Oppenheimer · me

I believe they couldn't. On a 7-point vote, the best one only got past 50%.

Einstein · a Transformer pretrained on ASHRAE

Then don't start from zero. I have already read 44,124 surveys. Give me a small adapter for your three sensors.

Einstein, leaving

And remember: God does not play dice. You will need three seeds.

Methods

Fewer labels

1.4%

of the 44,124 labeled records in ASHRAE DB II.

The strategy

Borrow, then adapt

Pretrain on the public database; train only a small adapter locally.

Source and target

Do the two datasets speak the same language?

𝒟S: XS∈ℝ12×17, NS=44,124𝒟T: XT∈ℝ12×6, NT=596

Each cell asks: is this local feature the same signal as that ASHRAE feature? Shuffled, it is noise.

Sorted by match

Five of 17 features match

Air temperature, humidity and the two season terms directly; clothing only as a season-based estimate.

The gap

Heart rate has no partner

So the pretrained input layer cannot be reused. An adapter learns the mapping into the model's space.

The source domain

ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II

44,124 records after cleaning, naturally ventilated buildings excluded, 7-point votes mapped to three classes.

Against the imbalance

Class-weighted cross-entropy

Rarer classes weigh more: Cool 1.28 · Warm 1.06 · Neutral 0.78.

T3C

A Transformer encoder for comfort

Six encoder layers, eight heads, and the last step (the survey moment) pooled into three classes.

≈3.2M parameters

Aminorroayaei, Chahardoli et al., ASHRAE 2026

Self-attention

A similarity matrix over time

A=softmax(QK⊤32)∈ℝ12×12

Each step's query is scored against every step's key; each row sums to 1.

Illustrative values · Vaswani et al., 2017

The Transformer, formally · ① embed

Z(0)=LN(XWe+be+P)

Each step's 17 features become a 256-wide vector, plus its position.

② ③ attend

Qh=ZWhQ,  Kh=ZWhK,  Vh=ZWhV,Ah=softmax(QhKh⊤32)

Eight heads, each with its own 12 × 12 attention matrix.

④ ⑤ ⑥ mix, add, normalize · ×6

Z~=LN(Z+Drop(MHSA(Z))),Z(ℓ)=LN(Z~+Drop(FFN(Z~)))

Heads are concatenated and projected; a feed-forward network widens to 512 and back.

⑦ classify

y^=softmax(Drop(z12(6))Wc+bc)

Keep step 12, the survey moment, and map it to three class probabilities.

Baseline

A bidirectional LSTM

Two stacked layers, 256 per direction; the last step goes to three classes.

Shared recipe

Same training for both backbones

Class-weighted cross-entropy, Adam, 55 epochs, batch 64, three seeds.

The BiLSTM, formally

Gates decide what to keep

ct=ft⊙ct−1+it⊙gtht=ot⊙tanh(ct)

f, i and o are sigmoid gates; g is the candidate memory.

Seeing the past

One hop versus eleven gates

z12=∑j=112A12,jvj

Attention reaches every step directly; in recurrence, step k passes 12 − k forget gates.

A structural difference, not a controlled test · illustrative values

The rare class

Learning behavior

Consistent with a steadier transfer

The Transformer adapter's validation ends close to training; the BiLSTM adapter's stays about 4–5 pp below its own training curve.

The research question, answered

Fewer variables, far less data, a similar accuracy level

Different datasets and class balance: a comparable level, not a head-to-head test. Majority-class baseline: 42.5% on ASHRAE, 50% locally.

06

Discussion

Same source accuracy, different transferability

Why the backbones diverged, and what the evidence does not show.

01Introduction02Full sensing03Field data04Methods05Results06Discussion07Conclusion

01 · Connection point

Where the adapter plugs in

T3C keeps all six pretrained encoder layers (five frozen); the BiLSTM loses one of its two recurrent layers and retrains the other.

02 · Stability

Every seed favors T3C

Lower spread across seeds: SD 1.36 vs 2.39 pp.

03 · Signal

Heart rate: not isolated

Same inputs for both adapters; no run without heart rate yet.

Interpretations, not controlled tests: with three seeds the gap is not statistically established (paired t-test, p ≈ 0.14).

Limitations

What the evidence does not show

Data

15 people, 2 rooms, one winter; no separate test set, so scores may be optimistic.

Source model

Synthesized history; survey inputs likely flatter the 71%.

Comparison

Architecture and capacity confounded; no from-scratch baseline; three seeds.

Step 1 chamber

5 participants; air quality co-varied with temperature.

Every graduate student, always

Me73.33% on validation. Time to write it up.
Also me…just one more seed.
07

Conclusion

What the evidence says

Four answers, each with its caveat.

01Introduction02Full sensing03Field data04Methods05Results06Discussion07Conclusion
Reduced sensing
73.33%

Feasible here: three sensed signals plus date-derived features (± 1.36; macro-F1 0.667).

Little local data
1.4%

Transfer was feasible with 596 local observations; a no-pretraining baseline on the same split is still to run.

Backbone
+5.55 pp

May matter for transfer: tied on ASHRAE, ahead in all three seeds after transfer. Capacity not yet separated.

Full sensing
ρ 0.77

Consistent with the design: in the chamber, air temperature tracked sensation most strongly.

Future work

Three directions

Stronger evaluation

Leave-one-participant-out · a baseline without pretraining · more warm-discomfort samples · source models without survey inputs

Richer data

A full year · wrist skin temperature · more rooms and climates

Toward control

Step-wise predictions for HVAC feedback · physics priors with a learned residual · an LLM reasoning layer grounded in ASHRAE 55 (ongoing)
